description: List the custom fonts uploaded to the connected Templated account, 25 per page by default (max 100). Templates can also use any Google Font by family name: set include_google_fonts to true to list those too, and query to search by name. Use this to choose a font_family for create_template or update_template, or to find the name for delete_font. Returns the font names plus total and hasMore.

include_google_fonts.description: Also list the Google Fonts available to every template (default: false)

query.description: Only fonts whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

name: list_fonts
